stories.title: Miss Grand International 2026: Tanzânia vence sua 1ª coroa mundial de beleza

en.title: Miss Grand International 2026: Tanzania wins its 1st world beauty crown
en.summary: Jihan Dimack from Tanzania was crowned Miss Grand International 2026 in Bangkok. This marks Tanzania's first victory in a major beauty pageant and the first win by an African competitor in the Grand International competition.

stories.title: 'Arruma a novinha', 'zero quilômetro': mensagens revelam esquema de aliciamento e abuso sexual de menores no Rio

en.title: 'Fix the young girl', 'brand new': messages reveal scheme of recruitment and sexual abuse of minors in Rio
en.summary: Police in Rio de Janeiro have indicted four people involved in a criminal organization operating a sexual exploitation scheme targeting minors. A university professor and lawyer identified as the scheme's leader has been detained since March.

stories.title: O que abre e fecha em Campo Grande no feriado de 12 de outubro

en.title: What opens and closes in Campo Grande on the October 12 holiday
en.summary: The October 12 holiday in Campo Grande will affect business hours for various establishments and services. Shopping centers and street commerce may operate on special schedules while some public services will remain closed.

stories.title: Economia no TO: Dorinha aposta na transformação local de matérias-primas; Vicentinho propõe silos coletivos e meta de pleno emprego

en.title: Economy in TO: Dorinha bets on local transformation of raw materials; Vicentinho proposes collective silos and full employment goal
en.summary: Two gubernatorial candidates in Tocantins have released economic plans emphasizing agricultural development and value-added production. Both candidates advance to a runoff election scheduled for October 25.

stories.title: Operações no aeroporto de Riad, na Arábia Saudita, permanecem suspensas após ataque

en.title: Operations at Riyadh airport in Saudi Arabia remain suspended after attack
en.summary: Airport operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia have remained suspended following an attack on the facility.

stories.title: Houthis emitem alerta de risco para novos ataques a aeroportos da Arábia Saudita

en.title: Houthis issue risk alert for new attacks on Saudi Arabian airports
en.summary: The Houthi group from Yemen has warned of potential future attacks on Saudi Arabian airports and urged airlines and travelers to avoid them, following an attack on Riyadh airport that killed 12 people and wounded over 300.

stories.title: Tão perto, mas tão longe: separadas por apenas 30 km, urnas registram maiores percentuais de votos para Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no RJ

en.title: Close yet far: separated by only 30 km, voting stations register highest vote percentages for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in Rio de Janeiro
en.summary: Two voting stations 30 kilometers apart in Rio de Janeiro recorded opposing 2026 election results, with Lula receiving 96.08 percent at one location in an indigenous community and Flávio Bolsonaro receiving 93.06 percent at the other.

stories.title: São Paulo tem alerta de perigo para tempestade neste domingo (11)

en.title: São Paulo has danger alert for storm this Sunday (11)
en.summary: A cold front arriving in São Paulo on Sunday is expected to bring moderate to heavy rainfall and instability during the afternoon hours.

stories.title: Lula e Flávio terão desafios distintos para governar

en.title: Lula and Flávio will face distinct challenges to govern
en.summary: Brazil's second round runoff on October 25, 2026 will determine whether incumbent president Lula wins a fourth term or opposition candidate Flávio Bolsonaro is elected, with each facing different governing challenges.

stories.title: Ataque de houthis interrompe operações no maior aeroporto da Arábia Saudita durante congresso mundial

en.title: Houthi attack disrupts operations at Saudi Arabia's largest airport during world congress
en.summary: Yemeni Houthi rebels repeated warnings to airlines and airport workers about operations at Saudi airports, following an attack on Riyadh's main airport that killed 12 people. The Iran-backed group urged staff and travelers to stay away from these facilities.

stories.title: Aeroporto de Riade segue fechado após ataque atribuído aos houthis

en.title: Riyadh airport remains closed after attack attributed to Houthis
en.summary: Riyadh International Airport will stay closed for an additional 24 hours following a missile attack attributed to Houthis by the Saudi-led coalition. The Saturday attack killed 12 people and wounded 309, causing extensive damage to terminals 3 and 4.

stories.title: Simepar prevê chuva e máxima de 26°C para Apucarana neste domingo

en.title: Simepar forecasts rain and high of 26°C for Apucarana this Sunday
en.summary: Weather forecasts indicate unstable conditions for Apucarana on Sunday with the possibility of rain at different times throughout the day, according to Paraná's Environmental Technology and Monitoring System.

stories.title: IA beneficia mais quem já tem melhores empregos, mostra estudo

en.title: AI benefits those who already have better jobs most, study shows
en.summary: A Gallup survey of over 15,000 U.S. professionals found that artificial intelligence disproportionately benefits those already in higher-quality positions with greater education and management roles, enhancing their productivity and creativity.

stories.title: Ministro do TSE derruba vídeo do vice de Flávio sobre suposto financiamento de Vorcaro a filme de Lula

en.title: TSE Minister Removes Video by Flávio's Running Mate About Alleged Vorcaro Financing of Lula Film
en.summary: A TSE minister ordered the removal of a video posted by Flávio Bolsonaro's vice-presidential candidate accusing President Lula of receiving bribes, citing an audio attributed to former banker Daniel Vorcaro regarding film financing.

stories.title: Flávio pede que TSE derrube canal ‘Exército do Lula’ no WhatsApp, e corregedoria quer esclarecimentos

en.title: Flávio Asks TSE to Remove 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp Channel, and Electoral Ombudsman Seeks Clarification
en.summary: An electoral ombudsman ordered candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to provide clarification within 72 hours regarding his request to remove a WhatsApp channel called 'Lula's Army' created by the politician.

stories.title: Lula aposta em conquistas sociais e Flávio promete mudanças, para abrir campanha do 2º turno

en.title: Lula Bets on Social Achievements and Flávio Promises Changes to Open Second Round Campaign
en.summary: President Lula's campaign emphasized preserving social policies and benefits, while candidate Flávio Bolsonaro focused on government proposals and refuting accusations during their opening of the second-round contest.

stories.title: Ratinho Jr declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno

en.title: Ratinho Jr Declares Support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Second Round
en.summary: The governor of Paraná announced his support for presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round runoff.
